title: Adic completion is Noetherian when the quotient is Noetherian and the ideal finitely generated
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $I\subseteq R$ an ideal such that (1) the quotient ring $R/I$ is Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and (2) $I$ is finitely generated. Let $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/I^n$ be the $I$-adic completion of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] and $IR^\wedge$ the ideal of $R^\wedge$ generated by the image of $I$ under the canonical map $R\to R^\wedge$. Then $R^\wedge$ is a Noetherian ring and $R^\wedge$ is $IR^\wedge$-adically complete [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring].

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05GH (lemma-completion-Noetherian, line 23011); used in the proof of Lemma Tag 0328 (lemma-cohen-rings-exist, line 44878).
